scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Why are you here?
Shouldn't you be at ^005DFFJeyna^000000's house?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
你怎麼在這裡？
你不是應該在^005DFF傑娜^000000的家裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I don't know what's going on, but the way I remember it you were supposed to be qualified to research ^FF4800Homunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
我不知道出了什麼事，但按我的記憶，你應該已經有資格研究^FF4800生命體^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Whatever the reason, you're not able to continue the research on ^FF4800Homunculus^000000.
Come back after you become a ^005DFFGenetic^000000 and have obtained a ^0000FFBioethics^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
不管是什麼原因，你現在都無法繼續研究^FF4800生命體^000000。
等你轉職為^005DFF基因學者^000000並學會^0000FF生命倫理^000000後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Wait, that embryo you have seems a little strange.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
等等，你帶著的那個胚胎好像有點奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Unless you have a job researching ^FF4800Homunculus^000000....
It will be of no help to you what so ever.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
如果不是研究^FF4800生命體^000000的職業，這東西對你可沒什麼用……

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I'm in charge of managing ^0000FFStrange Embryo^000000 so I'll take care of that for you.
No offense, and I'm not doing anything bad here.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
我負責管理^0000FF神奇的艾普理歐^000000，就交給我處理吧。別介意，我沒有惡意。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Weather's great.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
天氣真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Ready to go to my house?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
準備好去我家了嗎？

scripts.text: Go to ^005DFFViorel^000000's house.
scripts.translation: 前往^005DFF維奧雷爾^000000的家

scripts.text: Don't go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Good choice.
Now, close your eyes for a second...
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
選得好。
現在閉上眼睛一會兒……

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Come back when you're ready.
You must come with the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
準備好後再來。記得帶上^FF4800生命體^000000。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Why are you here?
Shouldn't you be at ^005DFFJeyna^000000's house?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
你怎麼在這裡？
你不是應該在^005DFF傑娜^000000的家裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Now, ready to go to ^005DFFJeyna^000000?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
好了，準備好去^005DFF傑娜^000000那裡了嗎？

scripts.text: Go to ^005DFFJeyna^000000's room.
scripts.translation: 前往^005DFF傑娜^000000的房間

scripts.text: Don't go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Good choice.
Now, close your eyes for a second...
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
選得好。
現在閉上眼睛一會兒……

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Come back when you're ready.
You must come with the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
準備好後再來。記得帶上^FF4800生命體^000000。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I used to be a merchant once, just like you.
I'm researching on ^FF4800Homunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
我以前也當過商人，就和你一樣。
現在我在研究^FF4800生命體^000000。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
If you're interested in ^FF4800Homunculus^000000, become an ^005DFFAlchemist^000000 or a ^005DFFCreator^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
對^FF4800生命體^000000感興趣的話，就轉職為^005DFF鍊金術士^000000或^005DFF創造者^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I've spent lots of time and energy on Homunculus.
If you feel like you're at a dead end, come back next time with a ^FF4800Homunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
我在生命體研究上花了很多時間和精力。如果你遇到瓶頸，下次帶著^FF4800生命體^000000再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Oh. Of course you need to have the suitable potentials. You could probably prove yourself once you become a ^FF4800Genetic^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
當然，你還得有足夠的潛力。成為^FF4800基因學者^000000後，應該就能證明自己了。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Oh, great~!
You have a ^FF4800Homunculus^000000.
With passion invested in its research we can make them better.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
太好了~你有^FF4800生命體^000000。只要投入熱情研究，就能讓它變得更強。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I must speak to you in private. Would you mind going to my house with me?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
我有些事想私下和你談談。能跟我去家裡一趟嗎？

scripts.text: Go to ^005DFFViorel^000000's home.
scripts.translation: 前往^005DFF維奧雷爾^000000的家

scripts.text: Stay here.
scripts.translation: 留在這裡

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Good choice.
Now, close your eyes for a second...
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
選得好。
現在閉上眼睛一會兒……

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
If you feel like you're at a dead end, come back next time with a ^FF4800Homunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
如果你遇到瓶頸，下次帶著^FF4800生命體^000000再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Hello again.
Perhaps you may be interested
in the newly created ^FF4800Homunculus^000000,
born from the new ^006400Homunculus Mutation System^000000?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
你好。也許你會對新誕生的^FF4800生命體^000000感興趣？它們是通過全新的^006400生命體變異系統^000000創造出來的。

scripts.text: Nope. Good bye.
scripts.translation: 不了，再見。

scripts.text: Please, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text: That's exactly what I wanted to hear.
scripts.translation: 這正是我想聽到的。

scripts.text: Why are you always standing there?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼總站在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Okay.
Good seeing you.
Good bye then~!
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
好。很高興見到你。
再見啦~！

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
!!!!
I... I see.
I thought you were here to see me.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
！！！！
我……明白了。
我還以為你是來看我的。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Just as I thought.
Let's have a look at the notes my dear friend Jeyna left.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
果然如此。來看看我親愛的朋友傑娜留下的筆記吧。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Hmm.
Well, that's all there is to it.
It's up to you to find out more.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
嗯……筆記就到這裡了。之後就得靠你自己探索。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
No, I do not stand here every day.
But why do YOU stand there every day?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
不，我不是每天都站在這裡。倒是你，為什麼每天都站在那兒？

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
What?
No, the way I see it
you seem to be here every time I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
什麼？不，在我看來，每次我來這裡都會碰見你。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Hmm, you seem to have a special bond with your ^FF4800Homunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
嗯，你和自己的^FF4800生命體^000000似乎有著特殊的羈絆。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Come back to me when that ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 reaches ^0000FFlevel 99^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
等你的^FF4800生命體^000000達到^0000FF99級^000000後，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
You do not yet possess an evolved ^FF4800Homunculus^000000...
As you may well know about evolution:
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
你的^FF4800生命體^000000還沒有進化……
你應該知道進化的條件：

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Using the ^0000FFStone of Sage^000000 when intimacy level is above ^006400Intimate^000000, the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 goes through ^006400Evolution^000000.

[Viorel]
^FF4800Homunculus^000000 research requires a lot of time and funding.
However, I believe passion is the most important factor.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
研究^FF4800生命體^000000需要投入大量時間和資金。不過，我認為熱情才是最重要的。

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text: Why are you always standing there?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼總站在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
So long~!
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
再見~！

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
You see, ^006400Alchemists^000000 have an inquisitive nature.
People like me, especially, even think of creating life itself.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
你看，^006400鍊金術士^000000天生就有好奇心。像我這樣的人，甚至會想創造生命。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
You'd have to research ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 to understand.
Now, if you'll excuse me~!
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
只有研究過^FF4800生命體^000000，你才會明白。那我先走了~！

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
What, is it so strange to see an Alchemist in their own lab?
How so?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
怎麼，在自己的實驗室裡看到鍊金術士很奇怪嗎？哪裡奇怪了？

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Huh?
Where's the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 you used to have?
Perhaps I've mistaken it for something else...
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
咦？你以前帶著的^FF4800生命體^000000呢？我可能認錯人了……

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
.......
 
(Seems to be thinking about something.)
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
……

（似乎在思考什麼。）

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Ha ha~
I think I've mistaken you for someone else.
If you'll excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
哈哈~
看來我認錯人了，失陪。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Good.
I see that you mean business.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
很好，看來你是認真的。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Maybe you'll agree.
Currently, your ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 is not in its perfect state.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
你或許也會這麼認為：現在你的^FF4800生命體^000000還不夠完美。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
These days, studies on the growth of the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 are actively taking place.
But, I do believe that I have found something special.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
最近大家都在積極研究^FF4800生命體^000000的成長。不過，我相信自己發現了某種特別之處。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
In order to break the current limitations of the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000, mutations need to happen.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
想突破^FF4800生命體^000000現有的限制，就必須讓它發生變異。

scripts.text: Like, biological experiments...?!
scripts.translation: 就像生物實驗那樣……？！

scripts.text: Well, yeah, naturally.
scripts.translation: 嗯，是啊，很自然。

scripts.text: I don't want to hurt my Homunculus!
scripts.translation: 我不想傷害我的生命體！

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Don't look so surprised.
Ethics in biology are kind of blurry right now, right?
I mean...
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
別那麼驚訝。現在的生物倫理界限確實有些模糊，不是嗎？我是說……

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
It's my duty to study the true potential of the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
研究^FF4800生命體^000000真正的潛能，是我的職責。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
So far, Homunculus haven't demonstrated their full potential, but I know that I am close to a breakthrough.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
到目前為止，生命體還沒有展現出全部潛能，但我知道自己離突破已經不遠了。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Yes.
I'm glad you're not upset.
Mutation,
a word that sparks evil in the minds of the ordinary,
which made my research very difficult to proceed with.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
沒錯。很高興你沒有生氣。
“變異”這個詞在普通人心裡總會引發負面聯想，害我的研究很難開展。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Do you remember?
^005DFFKellasus^000000 of ^8B4513Lighthalzen^000000, the pioneer of ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 research.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
你還記得研究^FF4800生命體^000000的先驅——^005DFF凱拉蘇斯^000000，來自^8B4513裡希塔樂鎮^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I believe that this research fulfills the promise made with ^005DFFKellasus^000000, the giver of knowledge and belief.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
我相信，這項研究能兌現我與^005DFF凱拉蘇斯^000000的約定。他是知識和信念的傳授者。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I understand your concern.
But I want to assure you that this Mutation does not harm or hurt your ^FF4800Homunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
我理解你的擔心。不過請放心，這種變異不會傷害你的^FF4800生命體^000000。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
On the contrary, the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 of today are in pain from imperfection, unable to live up to their supposed potentials.
Moreover, those ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 were often abandoned.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
恰恰相反，如今的^FF4800生命體^000000因自身的不完美而痛苦，無法發揮應有的潛能。
而且，^FF4800它們^000000常常遭到遺棄。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Don't get me wrong, I study the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 because I love them.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
別誤會，我研究^FF4800生命體^000000是因為我愛它們。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Well, by the way...
I have found this new mutation to be quite stable.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
對了...
我發現這種新型變異相當穩定。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
^006400The technology exists,
and they will likely have new
skills when mutated...^000000
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
^006400這項技術已經成熟，變異後生命體很可能會獲得新技能...^000000

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
The minor side effect...
^006400Their appearance will change^000000.
But I think you'll find that pretty satisfying.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
不過有個小小的副作用...
^006400外形會發生變化^000000。
但我想，你應該會喜歡這個變化。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I quote from ^005DFFKassibian^000000, an expert in ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 techniques,
^006400The truth is not in a single form~!^000000
Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
借用^005DFF卡西比安^000000——這位^FF4800生命體^000000技術專家的一句話：
^006400“真理不止一種形態~！”^000000
哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I know it's a little abrupt, but...
How about changing your ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 into something incredible with my marvelous achievement, the ^006400Homunculus Mutation System^000000?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
我知道這有點突然...
不過，要不要試試我引以為傲的發明——^006400生命體變異系統^000000？它能讓你的^FF4800生命體^000000變得與眾不同。

scripts.text: Explore the ^006400Homunculus Mutation System^000000.
Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Good choice.
Success lurks outside the box of conventional thinking, right?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
選得好。
成功往往藏在常規思維之外，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
The first person to help with the research is ^005DFFJeyna^000000.
I'll send you to ^005DFFJeyna^000000.
There, you'll learn more about the new ^0000FFHomunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
第一位協助研究的人是^005DFF傑娜^000000。
我送你去找^005DFF傑娜^000000。
在那裡，你能進一步瞭解這種新型^0000FF生命體^000000。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I don't see why you hesitate.
I am not trying to deceive you.
Maybe you need some time to think about it?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
我不明白你為什麼猶豫。
我可沒有騙你。
也許你需要些時間考慮？

scripts.text: Think about it.
scripts.translation: 再考慮一下

scripts.text: I'm just going to walk away.
scripts.translation: 我還是先走吧

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
We'll talk in a bit then.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
那我們過會兒再聊。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Shame.
However, I respect your opinion.
I'll send you back to the ^8B4513Laboratory^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
真遺憾。
不過，我尊重你的決定。
我送你回^8B4513實驗室^000000。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
The ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 I saw before has returned to its ^0000FFembryo^000000 state.
A little strange, but...
You don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
我之前見到的那隻^FF4800生命體^000000已經變回^0000FF胚胎^000000狀態了。
雖然有點奇怪...
但你不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
By the way...
I forgot to tell you something.
In order to stabilize the Mutation process, I need some materials first.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
對了...
我忘了告訴你一件事。
要讓變異過程穩定下來，我得先準備一些材料。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Fortunately, you don't have to find them yourself because I have them here already..
But, I'll need ^FF000050,000 zeny^000000, you know, as a service fee.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
幸好你不用自己去找，我這裡已經備好了。
不過得收你^FF000050,000 Zeny^000000，算作服務費。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I wish that I could do it for free but I'm not exactly made of money, you know.
That and I lack any investors to support my research at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
我也想免費幫你，可惜我並不富裕。
而且眼下也沒有投資者願意資助我的研究。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
In fact, if I had enough zeny to continue my research, then I could solve a lot of my problems...
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
要是我有足夠的 Zeny 繼續研究，很多問題就都能解決了...

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Anyways, you can try to do this with or without the stabilization process. It's all up to you.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
總之，穩定化與否由你決定。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
If you choose the unstable
mutation, I can't guarentee what kind of Homunculus you're going to get.
Anyways, it's up to you.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
如果你選擇不穩定變異，我可無法保證最後會得到什麼樣的生命體。
總之，一切由你決定。

scripts.text: Mutation stabilization (50,000 zeny)
scripts.translation: 穩定變異（50,000 Zeny）

scripts.text: Unstable mutation
scripts.translation: 不穩定變異

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I don't think you have ^FF000050 thousand Zeny^000000 with you right now.
Please bring enough Zeny.
I'll be waiting.
Want me to send you back to the ^8B4513Laboratory^000000?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
你身上好像沒有^FF000050,000 Zeny^000000。
請準備好足夠的 Zeny 再來，我會在這裡等你。
要我送你回^8B4513實驗室^000000嗎？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Yes. Send me back to the Lab.
scripts.translation: 好，送我回實驗室

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Alright.
I'll see you in a bit.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
好。
待會兒見。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Alright.
I'll be waiting at the ^8B4513Laboratory^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
好，我會在^8B4513實驗室^000000等你。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Good choice.
Choose from the different types of ^0000FFHomunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
選得好。
請選擇一種^0000FF生命體^000000。

scripts.text: Eira
scripts.translation: 艾拉

scripts.text: Sera
scripts.translation: 塞拉

scripts.text: Dieter
scripts.translation: 迪特

scripts.text: Bayeri
scripts.translation: 拜耶裡

scripts.text: Eleanor
scripts.translation: 伊蓮娜

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Are you sure?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
確定嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 確定

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I see.
Give it more time to think.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
知道了。
再考慮一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Excellent!
Let's get on with it.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
太好了！
那我們開始吧。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Now focus~!
You... need...
... concentration.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
現在集中精神~！
你...需要...
...專心。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Good. Almost done!
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
很好，快完成了！

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
So, your choice is the Unstable Mutation Process.
You believe in destiny?
Seriously...
Do you really wish to proceed
with the process of random outcome?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
所以，你選的是不穩定變異。
你相信命運嗎？
真是的...
你真的要進行這種結果完全隨機的變異嗎？

scripts.text: Go ahead. (Random Mutation)
scripts.translation: 繼續（隨機變異）

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
I see.
Give it more time to think.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
知道了。
再考慮一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Hmm...
The exploration of knowledge
is full of surprises.
.......
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
嗯...
探索知識的過程
總是充滿驚喜。
...

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Ha ha.
Hey, I feel like a Blacksmith!
Now let's get on with it.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
哈哈。
嘿，我感覺自己像個鐵匠！
好了，繼續吧。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Now focus~!
You... need...
... concentration.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
現在集中精神~！
你...需要...
...專心。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Concentrate a little more!
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
再集中一點精神！

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Good. Almost done!
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
很好，快完成了！

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Okay, Mutation Complete.
Phew... Didn't skip a heartbeat, did you?
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
好了，變異完成。
呼...你剛才沒緊張得心跳漏拍吧？

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Remember what ^005DFFKellasus^000000 said?
To the doorstep of the truth...
We must see for ourselves
the path that leads to it.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
還記得^005DFF凱拉蘇斯^000000說過的話嗎？
“要走到真理的門前...
就必須親自走過通往真理的道路。”

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
^0000FF{0}^000000,
I haven't known you
for a very long time,
but I get the feeling that
you'll achieve great things.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
^0000FF{0}^000000，
雖然我們相識不久，
但我有種預感，
你一定能成就一番事業。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Good luck on you adventures.
I hope that your new ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 will excel under your care.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
祝你冒險順利。
希望你的新^FF4800生命體^000000在你的照料下茁壯成長。

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
And don't you forget.
Our research
has only just begun~!
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
別忘了，
我們的研究
才剛剛開始~！

scripts.text:
[Viorel]
Now that all the work is done, I ask you to take your leave.
I need to recuperate.
scripts.translation:
[維奧雷爾]
既然事情都辦完了，就請回吧。
我得休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Welcome.
I just got word from ^005DFFViorel^000000 that you were coming.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
歡迎。
我剛收到^005DFF維奧雷爾^000000的訊息，知道你要來。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
By the way...
Did he convince you to do something...?
He does have a way with words.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
對了...
他說服你去做什麼了嗎？
他確實很會說話。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
He needs them because Alchemists are such awkward people.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
他需要這些東西，大概是因為鍊金術士都不太擅長處理這些事吧。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Anyways~
^0000FF{0}^000000 and ^005DFFViorel^000000 seem like two peas in a pod.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
總之~
^0000FF{0}^000000和^005DFF維奧雷爾^000000還真有點像呢。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Hahaha~ No offense.
I think it's a good thing.
Oh, yes.
You're here for the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 Mutation.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
哈哈~別介意，我覺得這是好事。
對了，你是來給^FF4800生命體^000000變異的吧。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
While I do some preparation,
why don't you take a look at that board?
The ^006400Homunculus Mutation System^000000 has ^0000FF5 different types^000000 of new mutations.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
我準備的時候，你先看看那塊告示板吧。
^006400生命體變異系統^000000有^0000FF五種^000000新型變異。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Your ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 can mutate into any of the 5 different forms.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
你的^FF4800生命體^000000可以變異成五種不同形態中的任意一種。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Let's see...
The ^006400Homunculus Mutation System^000000 includes new evolutions of the normal ^0000FFHomunculus^000000.
After they mutate, all previously learned skills will also remain.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
讓我看看...
^006400生命體變異系統^000000能讓普通^0000FF生命體^000000進化為新形態。
變異後，已經學會的技能也會保留。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
In other words...
Even if you change the magic wielder ^FF4800Vanilmirth^000000 to a fighter type,
skills such as Caprice will be
^006400retained and usable even after Mutation^000000.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
也就是說...
即使把擅長魔法的^FF4800香草米絲^000000變成戰鬥型，
善變等技能仍會^006400保留，變異後也能繼續使用^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Take a look at the Magic Board behind me and decide for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
看看我身後的魔法告示板，再自己做決定吧。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Take a look at the board behind me, on the right.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
看看我身後右邊的告示板。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Okay, I'm ready too.
In order to revert the process now, I need the Homunculus in its embryo form.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
好了，我也準備好了。
要逆轉變異過程，得先把生命體還原成胚胎。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
But,
You don't have enough space to carry an ^0000FFembryo^000000.
Please come back with enough space in your bag.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
不過，你的背包空間不夠，裝不下^0000FF胚胎^000000。
騰出足夠空間後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Please return to the ^8B4513Laboratory^000000.
You can find ^005DFFViorel^000000 at the ^8B4513Laboratory^000000 once you empty your bag.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
請先回^8B4513實驗室^000000。
清理好背包後，就能在^8B4513實驗室^000000找到^005DFF維奧雷爾^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
When you're done with emptying your bag, ask ^005DFFViorel^000000 to send you back here.
Go on and empty your bag~!
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
清理好背包後，讓^005DFF維奧雷爾^000000再送你回來。
快去整理背包吧~！

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Now's about time for a decision.
To go through the Mutation to the new ^0000FFHomunculus^000000 with the Homunculus Mutation System,
you need to go through the process of regression to turn the Homunculus back to its ^0000FFembryo^000000 state.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
該做決定了。
要通過生命體變異系統獲得新的^0000FF生命體^000000，
必須先經過逆轉過程，讓生命體恢復成^0000FF胚胎^000000狀態。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
And...
^006400You cannot use the ability Call Homunculus until the process is complete.^000000
It won't take long, so don't wander off.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
還有...
^006400這個過程完成前，你無法使用“召喚生命體”技能。^000000
用不了多久，別走遠了。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
So, please decide.
Do you want to proceed with the new ^0000FFHomunculus Mutation System^000000?
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
請做決定吧。
你要使用新的^0000FF生命體變異系統^000000嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是，我要進行變異

scripts.text: I need to think more.
scripts.translation: 我還想再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Oh, wait a minute.
To proceed with the Mutation, you need to wake up the Homunculus from the state of Vaporization.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
等一下。
要進行變異，得先讓氣化狀態的生命體恢復過來。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Come back after you've done that.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
處理好之後再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Good thinking.
It is unacceptable for Alchemists like us to fear challenge.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
考慮得很周到。
身為鍊金術士，可不能害怕挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Now I need you to focus.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
現在請集中精神。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
We need to...
Stabilize a little more.
.......
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
我們還得...
再穩定一些。
...

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
In a few moments, the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 will return to its embryo state.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
再過一會兒，^FF4800生命體^000000就會恢復成胚胎狀態。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Into a special embryo...
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
變成一顆特殊的胚胎...

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Phew~ All done.
Hmm, its state is a little strange.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
呼~總算完成了。
嗯，狀態好像有點奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
I guess it'll be just fine.
Don't lose that ^0000FFStrange Embryo^000000.
Also...
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
應該沒問題。
別弄丟了那顆^0000FF奇異胚胎^000000。
還有...

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Don't do anything like changing jobs or anything like that before the process is over.
If so, you, ^0000FF{0}^000000 might lose all the abilities you have over the Homunculus.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
在這個過程結束前，別轉職或做類似的事。
否則，^0000FF{0}^000000，你可能會失去對生命體的控制。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
All that concentration made me tired.
I'll just take a glass of water.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
剛才一直集中精神，真累。
我去倒杯水。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Maybe I shouldn't have asked in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
也許我一開始就不該問。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
^005DFFViorel^000000 will finish the mutation process.
Now it's my time to say good bye.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
接下來的變異由^005DFF維奧雷爾^000000完成。
我也該告辭了。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
It was short, but it was nice to meet you.
We'll see each other again some time.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
雖然相處時間不長，但很高興認識你。
以後有機會再見。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Best of luck~!
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
祝你好運~！

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Hey, how did you get in here?
Please get out. I'm changing~!
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
喂，你怎麼進來的？
快出去，我在換衣服~！

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Hey, wait.
The condition of the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 is not suitable.
That was close.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
等等。
^FF4800生命體^000000的狀態不合適。
好險，差點就出問題了。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
To use the Homunculus Mutation System
to change to the new
^FF4800Homunculus^000000,
the ^006400Homunculus must be above level 99 and evolved^000000.
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
要使用生命體變異系統，將生命體變為新的^FF4800生命體^000000，
^006400必須讓生命體達到99級以上並完成進化^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jeyna]
Come back to ^005DFFViorel^000000 when you're ready.
I'll see you later then~!
scripts.translation:
[傑娜]
準備好後再去找^005DFF維奧雷爾^000000。
回頭見~！

:: ^0000FFHomunculus^000000 research is
:: so much fun.
:: Be an Alchemist
:: who always enjoys
:: one's research.
scripts.translation:
[魔法告示板留言]
:: 研究^0000FF生命體^000000
:: 真有意思。
:: 做個熱愛研究、
:: 樂在其中的

:: Oh, and Viorel...

::

:: 對了，維奧雷爾...

::
::

[書櫃上的筆記]
瘋狂與天才在本質上有相似之處，因為二者都屬於異常現象。
觀察了^8B4513吉芬^000000的鍊金術士^005DFF莫根斯坦^000000後，我認為兩者並無區別。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
Once I had to visit...
the strange ^005DFFMorgenstein^000000 for research purposes.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
有一次，為了研究...
我不得不去拜訪那位古怪的^005DFF莫根斯坦^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
I had a meat stew before I met ^005DFFMorgenstein^000000,
surprisingly enough, he muttered that he smelled meat even before I was close.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
去見^005DFF莫根斯坦^000000之前，我吃了燉肉。
沒想到還沒走近，他就嘀咕說聞到了肉味。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
I never thought that chemists had a great sense of smell.
The next time I give
^005DFFMorgenstein^000000 a visit,
I'll eat some other meal.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
我從沒想過鍊金術士的嗅覺這麼靈。
下次拜訪^005DFF莫根斯坦^000000時，我要換點別的吃。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
^005DFFDe Bris^000000 thinks the enthusiasm of Alchemists has lately dropped <Dramatically>...
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
^005DFF德布里斯^000000認為，鍊金術士們最近的熱情<Dramatically>下降了...

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
He especially didn't like the fact that I was bound tightly to ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 research.
He didn't say such a thing when we studied together in ^8B4513Rune-Midgarts^000000.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
他尤其不喜歡我一心撲在^FF4800生命體^000000研究上。
當年我們在^8B4513盧恩·米德加茲^000000一起學習時，他可沒這麼說。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
One day, I'll show ^005DFFDe Bris^000000 my ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 research data.
I love watching him jump out of his skin.... I look forward to the day.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
總有一天，我要把^FF4800生命體^000000研究資料拿給^005DFF德布里斯^000000看。
我最愛看他嚇一大跳的樣子...真期待那一天。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
^005DFFDe Bris^000000' passion for the ^57007FGenetic^000000 arts is amazing.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
^005DFF德布里斯^000000對^57007F基因學^000000的熱情真令人佩服。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
Recently, the Alchemist Union offered me the chance to join the ^57007FGenetic^000000 through a letter.
I wonder what ^005DFFDe Bris^000000 said to the union...
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
最近鍊金術士公會來信，邀請我加入^57007F基因學者^000000行列。
不知道^005DFF德布里斯^000000對公會說了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
Well, I appreciate it...
However, for me right now
my research is of utmost priority.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
嗯，我很感激...
不過眼下對我來說，研究才是最重要的。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
There's something funny ^005DFFDarcia^000000 said to me.
It was about when ^005DFFJeyna^000000 first came to learn about potion combination......
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
^005DFF達西亞^000000跟我說過一件趣事。
說的是^005DFF傑娜^000000剛開始學習調配藥水時的事...

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
She did good up to the stage of pouring water into the mixture.
She just had to put it into an empty bottle...
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
她順利完成了把水倒進混合物這一步。
接下來只要裝進空瓶就行了...

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
^005DFFDarcia^000000 watched what she would do with the last stage,
and the confused ^005DFFJeyna^000000 drank the mixture out of the bowl and told her that it healed well.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
^005DFF達西亞^000000等著看她怎麼完成最後一步，
結果不知所措的^005DFF傑娜^000000直接喝掉了碗裡的混合物，還告訴她藥效很好。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
To think that even ^005DFFJeyna^000000,
now a master of potion combination,
had her rookie mistakes
shows how hard it is to imagine
and forecast one's past and future.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
如今的^005DFF傑娜^000000已是藥水調配大師，可她當年也犯過新手錯誤。
由此可見，人很難想像並預知自己過去和未來的模樣。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
^005DFFVincent^000000, I think I did it.
I will never forget your words of courage 
and I am grateful that I now get to pay you back.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
^005DFF文森特^000000，我想我成功了。
我永遠不會忘記你鼓勵我的話，也很感激終於有機會報答你。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
It was indeed a long process.
When many of the union
considered my research insignificant
... Though I did not lose my belief
it did heart deep inside.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
這段路確實走了很久。
公會裡不少人都覺得我的研究毫無意義...雖然我沒有放棄信念，心裡卻還是受到了重創。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
The few friends who believed me
especially ^005DFFJeyna^000000
and you ^005DFFVincent^000000 ...
I am sincerely thankful with all my soul.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
少數相信我的朋友，尤其是^005DFF傑娜^000000，
還有你，^005DFF文森特^000000...
我由衷地感謝你們。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
They say that,
the end justifies the means.
At first,
I did not know what it meant...
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
人們常說，
結果可以證明手段正當。
起初，
我並不明白這句話的意思...

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
Now I know.
I know how important it is
to follow one's heart.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
現在我懂了。
追隨自己的內心有多重要，我也明白了。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
I'll drop by very soon.
Be well until then.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
我很快就會去拜訪你。
這段時間多保重。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
A game called ^0000FFThe Epic Battle 2^000000, similar to chess, was intriguing.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
有款叫^0000FF《史詩之戰2》^000000的遊戲很有意思，玩法和國際象棋相似。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
Some time ago, I met a ^0000FFFruit Seller^000000 who excelled in The Epic Battle 2.
He even overcame the infamous ^006400Grizzly Shockwave Strategy^000000 and ^006400God of Death Terror^000000 with ease.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
前陣子，我遇到一位^0000FF水果商^000000，玩《史詩之戰2》特別厲害。
臭名昭著的^006400暴焰野熊衝擊戰術^000000和^006400死神恐懼^000000，他都輕鬆破解了。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
To overcome those in the early stages of the battle of the ^0000FFPriest Faction^000000...
It is difficult for me, since I need to combine the pieces and use some luring skills.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
要在^0000FF牧師陣營^000000的戰鬥初期破解那些戰術...
對我來說可不容易，得組合棋子，還要用些引誘戰術。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
I wonder when I'll become a 3 Carat Diamond level player.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
不知道我什麼時候才能升到3克拉鑽石段位。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
There are many Alchemists who like the ^FF4800Vanilmirth^000000.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
很多鍊金術士都喜歡^FF4800香草米絲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
But I prefer the ^FF4800Amistr^000000.
It's cute when it wags its tale with those shiny eyes.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
不過我更喜歡^FF4800阿米斯特^000000。
它總用亮晶晶的眼睛望著我，還會搖尾巴，真可愛。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
My Amistr Jonathan is clever and mellow, making it ever so lovable.
We're good friends, aren't we Jonathan?
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
我的阿米斯特喬納森既聰明又溫順，實在惹人喜愛。
我們是好朋友，對吧，喬納森？

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
What should I write to ^005DFFDe Bris^000000.
:: To my noted 
:: Genetic friend De Bris.
:: How's Lighthalzen?
:: Do they have enough of those
:: cookies you oh so love?
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
我該給^005DFF德布里斯^000000寫些什麼呢？
:: 致我敬愛的
:: 基因學者朋友德布里斯。
:: 裡希塔樂鎮怎麼樣？
:: 你最愛的餅乾
:: 還夠吃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
:: I'll drop by soon
:: with some cookies.
:: When we meet,
:: I'll introduce you to my
:: ^006400New Homunculus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
:: 我很快會帶些餅乾
:: 去看你。
:: 到時候，
:: 我會把我的^006400新生命體^000000
:: 介紹給你。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
:: No need to be alert.
:: Unlike you,
:: they aren't interested in 
:: what others have to eat.
:: I'll see you soon~!
:: Dare close the door on me.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
:: 不用這麼警惕。
:: 它們不像你，
:: 對別人吃什麼
:: 一點興趣也沒有。
:: 很快見~！
:: 你可別又把門關上啊。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
The last time I visited the Alchemist Union, there was an interesting debate on the table.
I think it was something to do with ^006400Negligence of Homunculus in public places^000000.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
上次去鍊金術士公會時，我聽到桌邊有人在討論一件有趣的事。
好像是關於^006400生命體在公共場所造成的麻煩^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
While the master dozed off,
one of the ^FF4800Homunculus^000000 off its leash
caused some sort of problem.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
主人打盹時，
一隻掙脫束縛的^FF4800生命體^000000
惹出了什麼麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
I will make sure that my Homunculus Jonathan...
is trained well not to cause trouble around other people.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
我得好好訓練我的生命體喬納森...
不能讓它在別人面前惹麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
There's a new toy me and ^005DFFJeyna^000000 have grown fond of.
It's relatively new,
called... ^0000FF'Helo'^000000, I think?
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
我和^005DFF傑娜^000000最近都迷上了一種新玩具。
聽說是新出的，
好像叫...^0000FF“Helo”^000000？

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
There was a related song to it, sung by some ^57007FMinstrel^000000.
The lyrics were something like ^006400'Ahhh~Ahh~Ahhhhhhhh'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
有位^57007F宮廷樂師^000000還為它唱了首歌。
歌詞大概是^006400“啊~啊~啊啊啊啊啊”^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
The entertainment itself is fun,
but the music is also excellent,
and when I listen to it
it feels like my SP is restored significantly.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
表演本身很有趣，
音樂也特別棒。
聽著聽著，
感覺SP都恢復了不少。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
I must say,
entertainment is crucial when resting
to boost morale for research.
^006400For Homunculus~!^000000
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
不得不說，
休息時聽聽娛樂節目，對提振研究士氣很重要。
^006400為了生命體~！^000000

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
From what I heard from the union member
^005DFFParmy^000000,
^005DFFRaspuchin^000000 is still his own weird self.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
聽公會成員^005DFF帕爾米^000000說，
^005DFF拉斯普欽^000000還是老樣子，古怪得很。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
It may not be such a good idea
to drive those energetic souls
coming to change jobs
with such enthusiasm.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
那些滿懷熱情來轉職的年輕人精力充沛，
用這種態度把他們趕走，恐怕不太妥當。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
A friend of mine who was into painting,
suggested making a <Graphic Novel> called
^0000FFMUTATIONER^000000
after he heard about my research
and my works.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
我有位喜歡繪畫的朋友，聽完我的研究和成果後，
建議創作一部名為^0000FFMUTATIONER^000000的<影像小說>。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
The story begins...
With an alien
^FF4800Homunculus^000000
visiting our world.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
故事開始了...
一隻外星^FF4800生命體^000000
來到了我們的世界。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
The visiting alien
^FF4800Homunculus^000000 can survive
without a master
and it could change into
various creatures that
roam our world.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
這隻來訪的外星^FF4800生命體^000000
不需要主人也能生存，
還能變成各種生物，
在我們的世界四處活動。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
These alien^FF4800Homunculus^000000
have two opposing factions
divided by political differences.
In our world, we call them
^006400Aut-homun^000000 and 
^006400Decept-homun^000000
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
這些外星^FF4800生命體^000000
因政治分歧分成了兩個對立陣營。
在我們的世界裡，它們被稱為
^006400Aut-homun^000000和
^006400Decept-homun^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
The ^006400Aut-homun^000000 are our friends.
Their leader,
called ^005DFFOptimus Poring^000000,
is built and so cool
for a poring,
and it summons a cart at will!
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
^006400Aut-homun^000000是我們的朋友。
它們的首領叫^005DFF擎天波利^000000，
作為波利來說，造型精良又酷勁十足，
還可以隨心所欲地召喚手推車！

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
The opposing side, the ^006400Decept-homun^000000,
is led by ^005DFFMegatroll^000000
and they use all means 
to destroy our world.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
對立陣營^006400Decept-homun^000000
由^005DFF巨魔^000000領導，
它們不擇手段地
企圖毀滅我們的世界。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
The hero of this story
is one from ^8B4513Alberta^000000 called ^005DFFJam Wicky^000000,
who meets ^005DFFOptimus Poring^000000
while shopping for a cart,
as if it was his destiny.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
故事的主角是來自^8B4513艾爾貝塔^000000的^005DFF傑姆·威基^000000。
他去買手推車時遇見了^005DFF擎天波利^000000，
彷彿一切都是命中註定。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
And so thus
unfolds an epic battle
in the ^8B4513Moroc Desert^000000
where the fate of our world
lies in his hands...
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
於是，一場史詩般的戰鬥
在^8B4513夢羅克沙漠^000000展開。
世界的命運
就掌握在他手中...

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
Enough of that~!
The rest of the story can be
checked in the published copy.
^0000FFMUTATIONER^000000
It's going to be awesome~!
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
故事先說到這裡~！
後續可以看出版的作品。
^0000FFMUTATIONER^000000
一定會很精彩~！

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
The Union sent a special gift to its members.
It's called a ^0000FFHigh Clip 4^000000.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
公會給成員送了一份特別禮物，
叫作^0000FF高夾4^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
It is originally used as a tool to allow easy whispering between members, but it also has other useful functions.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
它原本是方便公會成員互相密語的工具，
不過還有不少實用功能。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
A guild invented this. I recall that their emblem had an image of an apple.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
這是某個公會發明的。
我記得他們的徽章上畫著一顆蘋果。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
Homunculus is indeed worthy.
However, like everyone else, I sometimes question its meaning and future.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
生命體確實很有價值。
不過，和其他人一樣，我有時也會思考它的意義與未來。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
I believe that life given by nature was supposed to be used for oneself.
However...
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
我相信，自然賦予的生命原本應該由自己支配。
然而...

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
The research to give the Homunculus life is, in reality, for the benefit of man.
Perhaps mankind is not ready ethically to create life.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
賦予生命體生命的研究，說到底是為了人類自身的利益。
也許在人類準備好承擔道德責任之前，還不該創造生命。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
Some time ago, ^005DFFJeyna^000000 introduced me to someone.
She is from ^8B4513Geffen^000000,
and she introduced herself as a ^005DFFChicken Researcher^000000.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
不久前，^005DFF傑娜^000000介紹我認識一個人。
她來自^8B4513吉芬^000000，自稱是^005DFF小雞研究員^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
She is an expert on something called the ^006400Legendary Bijofnil^000000.
She finds it offensive that people think that the Bijofnil is a hawk.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
她專門研究所謂的^006400傳奇比約菲尼爾^000000。
她很反感別人把比約菲尼爾當成鷹。

scripts.text:
[Bookcase Notes]
She said something about somewhere in ^8B4513Hvergilmir's Fountain^000000
there exists a ^005DFFtalking chicken^000000 and other stories...
Well, it went on like that
and it was interesting.
scripts.translation:
[書櫃上的筆記]
她還說，在^8B4513赫維吉爾姆之泉^000000的某處，
有一隻^005DFF會說話的小雞^000000...
諸如此類的故事還有不少，
聽起來挺有意思。

scripts.text:
[Jonathan]
Hwang~ Hwang!
scripts.translation:
[喬納森]
咕~咕！

scripts.text:
:: It seems to be Viorel's
:: Homunculus.
:: It is wearing a small necklace
:: with the name Jonathan engraved
:: on it.
scripts.translation:
:: 這似乎是維奧雷爾的
:: 生命體。
:: 它戴著一條小項鍊，
:: 上面刻著喬納森的名字。

scripts.text:
[Jonathan]
Hwang~?!
scripts.translation:
[喬納森]
咕~？

scripts.text:
[Jonathan]
*Sniff* ...
scripts.translation:
[喬納森]
*嗅嗅* ...

scripts.text:
:: This Amistr
:: called Jonathan
:: seems to be surprised by my
:: new Homunculus.
scripts.translation:
:: 這隻名叫喬納森的
:: 阿米斯特
:: 似乎對我的新生命體
:: 感到驚訝。
